title: A torsion-free counterexample to the Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture
main_claim: There is a finitely generated torsion-free group Γ = Γbase * F_N and a projection e in C*_r(Γ) with 0 < τ(e) < 1/2. Γbase is an infinite graphical presentation built from a voltage cover, over a torsion-free nilpotent deck group F, of an expanding layered tower Y. A matrix projection p0 ∈ M_N(C*_r(Γbase)) with small unnormalized trace is compressed to a scalar projection using N free generators.
coverage: Checked line by line: (1) Scalar compression (Prop scalar:compression). I checked the good/bad position split, the pointwise Cauchy–Schwarz bound |ξ_j(v)|² ≤ a_j m_v, the injectivity of the bad-output map, and the lower bound ||Uξ|| ≥ (sqrt(1-a) - sqrt(a))||ξ||, which needs a < 1/2. Also V*V = p, trace preservation, and torsion-freeness of the free product. (2) Spectral section: the compression lemma constants (a+12ε ≤ a+20ε; ||V-E|| ≤ 2ε), the contour perturbation bound u/(r0-u), the cover-projection fiber-trace equality via equivariant equivalences, the resolvent-series layer decay ||P_i E_P(t)|| ≤ 4θ^dist with weighted sum ≤ 6 max w_j (so S ≤ 96μ), the ball Hilbert–Schmidt bound, the forest norm 2w√m, the global gap ||T-C|| ≤ 3α, and the trace argument. The trace argument covers the equivariant restriction map A into ⊕_Q E_Q with Tr = Σ_v e_v, the loss bound paid by the layer weights, the kernel quadratic-form bound, and the injectivity of P_{K⊥} on p0H. (3) Geometry: the incidence bijection, the cycle-space directness, the forest proof, and the one-ball ordering argument (both cases of the L* path). Also the tree-ness of B(Q) from girth versus R_Q, the constant ordering C_*, C_•, the Euler/arc count (20J ≤ 6J), and the thin-triangle integral bound. (4) Nilpotent part: the homogeneity of the twisted Riemann sums giving trace ≍ |θ|^{n_f} with uniformly bounded ℓ¹ norm, magnetic absorption with an N-fold trace, the window estimate t(δ-t) ≤ 2^κ q^{-2} 2^{-κ|i|}, and the exponent bookkeeping in nil:weighted. (5) Sampling: the Følner finite-test lemma, the empirical-list moments, the Schwartz–Zippel girth union bound (2^{(3C_*+3)H} walks against 2^{-E0 H}), the walk count and rank bound, the block moment Markov bound 2^{(C1 - C2/2)H_i}, the compactness choice, and the 6ε assembly. Not checked line by line: the bit-stream slot algebra of the tower (tower.tex), the conditional Fourier/cut-tail expansion lemmas giving the absolute gap χ (expansion.tex), and the prefix-recovery/pruning budget (pruning.tex). I took the outputs of Prop prune:tower-properties as given.
sibling_notes: The sibling Baum–Connes injectivity paper (rank 325) also reported no_gap_found. This paper's argument is self-contained apart from the cited Bass companion, which is used only for context remarks (that the group ring has no idempotents), not in the proof.
